the mind, nor confesses [him] with the mouth. The
person is freed from the evil spirit when
the priest, or whoever baptises there, blows away the devil
and conjures [him] in the name of the Father and of the Son and
of the Holy Spirit, that he depart from the person
and give place to the living and true God: that he give place to the
true and the living God. The person also becomes
